    <div class="stop-card reveal" style="--d:.24s"><div class="num">03 · The Netherlands</div><h3>Global sourcing</h3><p>Now leading distribution sourcing for Prodrive across four regions: strategy with distribution partners, supplier relationships, and the processes behind them.</p></div>

<section class="sec" style="padding-top:1rem"><div class="wrap">
  <div class="quote-sec reveal">
    <div class="kicker">Where supply chain meets data</div>
    <blockquote>The weakest decisions I have seen were driven by metrics that looked precise and <span class="mark">measured the wrong thing.</span></blockquote>
    <p>That is why I am completing a Master of Science in Supply Chain Management with a concentration in Data Analytics at Boston University (December 2026). I never set out to be an engineer. I wanted to be fluent enough to stand between the people who build data tools and the people who depend on them: to follow how information moves through SAP and out to suppliers, and to design KPIs that reflect how an operation really runs.</p>
  </div>
</div></section>

<section class="sec" style="padding-top:1rem"><div class="wrap">
  <div class="reveal">
    <div class="kicker">What shapes my work</div>
    <h2>A market that does not <em>stand still.</em></h2>
  </div>
  <div class="forces">
    <div class="force reveal" style="--d:0s"><div class="ico"><i class="bi bi-cpu"></i></div><h3>Complexity</h3><p>Semiconductors are among the most complex products in the world to make and to move. One component can cross several countries before it reaches a production line, and capacity cannot be added quickly.</p></div>
    <div class="force reveal" style="--d:.12s"><div class="ico"><i class="bi bi-stars"></i></div><h3>Artificial intelligence</h3><p>Demand for AI hardware has redrawn the market, shifting where capacity goes and changing availability and pricing for everyone else.</p></div>
    <div class="force reveal" style="--d:.24s"><div class="ico"><i class="bi bi-globe-europe-africa"></i></div><h3>Geopolitics</h3><p>Trade policy, export controls, and tariffs now influence sourcing decisions as much as price and lead time do.</p></div>
  </div>
</div></section>

<section class="sec"><div class="wrap life">

    <h2>Life, lately in <em>Dutch.</em></h2>
    <ul class="life-list">
      <li><i class="bi bi-compass"></i><div><b>Trade history</b><span>I am fascinated by how centuries of routes, ports, and agreements shaped the supply chains we manage today. Moving to one of history's great trading nations has not hurt.</span></div></li>
            <li><i class="bi bi-heart"></i><div><b>Paxton</b><span>My miniature Australian shepherd, who relocated with me. He has no interest in my career path, but he loves his new backyard: open fields, and the cows next door.</span></div></li>
      <li><i class="bi bi-signpost-split"></i><div><b>What is next</b><span>Strategic supply chain development and process design are the work I enjoy most, and I am building toward leading the teams that do it.</span></div></li>
    </ul>
  </div>
